push.title: Webhooks na luar - Push Leads & Updates
push.intro: Boi iubah ganup per webhook : JSON , Form (x-www-form-urlencoded), atap template badan khusus nasiam sandiri pakon <fieldkey></fieldkey> placeholders (misalni <example></example> ) - marhorja songon mangisi parentah cURL sahali.

push.curlHelp: Tempelhon ma contoh pangindoan na ibere dokumen API ni sidea atap Postman (pakon data na nyata atap contoh). URL , metode pakon header isalin songon na adong, anjaha ganup kunci bani badanni isuratkon i toruh ase boi ipilih nasiam bidang CRM na ija do na manggoki ai bani ganup lead.

api.title: API nasiam - Akses Dua Arah bani Sistem Sagala
api.intro: Sistem aha pe na mamakei kunci API nasiam boi mambahen, mambasa pakon paimbaruhon prospek pakon langganan bani acara prospek. Kirim ma kunci ai bani <hdr></hdr> header, songon <bearer></bearer> , atap (anggo alat ai lang boi mangatur header) songon <query></query> . Batas: {{limit}} pangindoan per menit.
api.noPermission: Pitah halak na marhak mangatur pengaturan do na boi mangidah kunci API .
api.shownOnce: Salin ma kunci on sonari anjaha simpan ma ai bani ianan na aman - ase aman pitah sahali do ai ipatuduh. Anggo magou, bahen ma na baru.
api.regenerateConfirm: Mambahen kunci API na baru? Kunci sonari mintor maronti marhorja bani ganup sistem na mamakei ai.
api.openApiHint: Impor ma spesifikasi OpenAPI hu Postman , Zapier , Make atap n8n ase ganup endpoint sirsir ipakei.
